paragraphs: Abba bar Acha bar Salla of Kafri. His five children: Ivo, Rav’s father; Chana, father of Rabbah bar bar Chana; Shila, Rava’s father; Marta, mother of Rabbi Shmuel bar Marta; and Rabbi Chiyya the great (Sanhedrin 5a). But in Rashi, Pesachim 4, beginning of a, and Mo'ed Katan 20, end of a, these five children are the children of Rabbi Achi of Kafri. (See also below, Rabbi Chiyya the great.) See below, Marta: it is a man’s name, Rabbi Chiyya’s brother. See Shmuel bar Marta: Yuchasin is uncertain whether it is a man’s name or a woman’s.
